ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a schematic diagram of a circular Earth, O is located at the center of the circle; EF is the horizontal diameter passing through O, and the problem states that EF is the equator; the vertical diameter passing through O can be regarded as the direction of the Earth's axis, and the upper end corresponds to the direction of the North Pole. Point P is in the upper right of the Northern Hemisphere of the circle, and 20° is marked between OP and the vertically upward North Pole direction, so point P is 20° away from the North Pole. Then reason: Latitude is calculated from the equator, and the North Pole is 90°N, so the latitude of point P is 90°−20°=70°N. When polar night occurs at latitude 70°N in the Northern Hemisphere, the noon solar altitude is not higher than the horizon, namely 90°−|70°−δ|≤0, where δ is the latitude of the direct solar point. To make 70°N enter polar night, the direct solar point must be in the Southern Hemisphere and at least reach 20°S, namely δ≤20°S. Also because the direct solar point can only go as far south as the Tropic of Capricorn 23°26′S, the range of direct solar radiation is from 20°S to 23°26′S.

If EF is the equator, and point P has the phenomenon of polar night, then what is the range of direct solar radiation?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: EF is the equator, O is the center, and OP lies 20° from the north pole direction, so P's latitude is 90°−20°=70°N. Since P出现极夜, require noon solar altitude at P not above the horizon: 90°−|70°−δ|≤0. This implies the Sun must be directly over the Southern Hemisphere at least 20° south, i.e. δ≤20°S. Because the subsolar point cannot go beyond the Tropic of Capricorn, δ ranges from 20°S to 23°26′S.

再推理：纬度从赤道起算，北极为 90°N，所以 P 点纬度为 90°−20°=70°N。北半球纬度 70°N 出现极夜时，正午太阳高度不高于地平线，即 90°−|70°−δ|≤0，其中 δ 为太阳直射点纬度。要使 70°N 进入极夜，太阳直射点必须在南半球且至少达到 20°S，即 δ≤20°S。又因为太阳直射点最南只能到南回归线 23°26′S，所以太阳直射范围为 20°S 到 23°26′S。
